title: xDrip randomly opens
symptom: xDrip randomly opens over the current app when using other apps, on Android 7.1.1 devices (Nexus 6P and Nexus 5X).
cause: The issue is related to sync features; disabling all sync features works as a workaround, and a nightly build restructured sync to resolve it.
fix: As a workaround, enable 'Disable all sync features' in xDrip+ Sync Settings. A nightly build (2017.01.10) restructured sync and was expected to resolve the issue, though one user reported it still happened once after updating.
evidence_quote: Ok, if you are experiencing this issue and you are NOT using any of the master/follower features, then as a work-around, go in to `xDrip+ Sync Settings` and enable the checkbox: `Disable all sync features`
